click: a single small plastic remote control button click, close
self_pop: a small electronic gadget blowing itself up in someone's hands: one sharp little bang, crackle and a sputter, close, no music
steps_lab: slow footsteps of one person in soft leather shoes on a bare concrete basement floor, eight separate steps with short gaps, dry, no music, no voices
run_lab: one person running fast in sneakers across a bare concrete floor, ten separate quick footsteps, dry, no music, no voices
unroll: a very long paper receipt unrolling fast and spilling onto the floor, rustling paper
cloth: four separate quick rustles of a stiff cotton lab coat sleeve as arms are thrown up, close, dry, pauses between, no voice
chalk: chalk drawing a big circle on a chalkboard, one continuous scrape
thud: a heavy metal fire extinguisher slammed down on a lab bench, a solid clank
oven_hum: a countertop electric oven running: steady convection fan whir and a low heating element hum, close, no music
oven_door: a small countertop oven door pulled open on its spring hinge, then snapped shut: metal creak and a clunk, close, no music
cash_drop: a small stack of paper banknotes and a few coins dropped onto a metal oven rack: a soft paper slap and a coin jingle, close
alarm_clock: an old wind-up twin bell alarm clock ticking loudly on a table, close, steady ticks, no ringing, no music
